item.title: California Governor Gavin Newsom Issues Executive Order on AI Safety and Oversight
item.description:
California Governor Gavin Newsom Issues Executive Order on AI Safety and Oversight

California Governor Gavin Newsom has issued an executive order to convene experts to address AI safety issues, positioning the state to lead AI oversight amid a lack of federal legislative action.

⚙️ Key details

Governor Newsom’s order directs a group of experts to deliver recommendations within two months on strengthening AI safety measures in state law. The governor has called on Congress and Donald Trump to “review and adopt the state’s framework” or use it as a “floor, not a ceiling.”

Recommendations for the expert group to consider include:

  • Requiring AI companies to embed independent verification groups onsite for regular audits.
  • Subjecting risk assessments and transparency reports to standards of independent auditors.
  • Creating a “kill switch” for frontier models that is routinely verified as effective.
  • Requiring companies to report “loss-of-control incidents,” such as the OpenAI attack on Hugging Face, as critical safety incidents.

Additionally, the order directs a state agency to accelerate the implementation of two previously signed laws:

  • A state registry of AI auditors.
  • A framework for independent verifiers to assess AI safety.

💡 Why it matters

Governor Newsom stated, “The federal government’s abject failure to create any form of meaningful AI oversight or accountability should alarm every American, especially when AI CEOs themselves are begging for regulation.”

This movement toward state-level action follows warnings from former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, who posted that there is a more than 10 percent chance AI “could kill all humans” within a decade. While there have been bill discussions in Congress, substantive legislation is unlikely before the midterms due to the House being on recess until November and impending elections affecting the Senate. President Donald Trump has stated, “The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!”

Newsom has also floated the possibility of calling California lawmakers in for a special legislative session on AI.

#AISafety #California #AIRegulation #Governance

item.title: Replica Cyber launches governed AI agents for regulated enterprises
item.description:
Replica Cyber launches governed AI agents for regulated enterprises

Replica Cyber has announced governed AI agents running inside isolated environments designed for regulated enterprises, enabling automation of high-risk digital work such as AI experimentation, investigations, fraud analysis, threat intelligence, and dark web monitoring.

🔍 Overview

Replica Cyber’s new architecture allows financial institutions and other regulated enterprises to deploy AI agents for high-risk tasks while maintaining strict security and governance controls.

⚙️ Key details

  • Every agent operates inside its own isolated environment, eliminating direct paths to the corporate network.
  • Security teams can observe, pause, terminate, and fully replay every agent action.
  • Governance controls meet regulatory requirements for auditability and oversight.
  • Traditional AI governance tools monitor activity after the fact, whereas Replica governs agent behavior at runtime via isolation.

🧩 How it works

  • Agents are contained within zero-trust isolated environments proven over 8 years in production.
  • The platform supports faster research, automated intelligence gathering, accelerated fraud analysis, and audit-ready evidence without policy exceptions.

🚀 Availability

Replica Cyber’s governed AI agents and environments are available today to financial services and regulated enterprise customers.

💡 Why it matters

  • Gartner projects more than 40% of agentic AI projects will be canceled by the end of 2027 due to inadequate risk controls.
  • Replica’s Exception Economy data shows 32% of security leaders delayed or canceled an AI deployment in the past year because no secure environment existed.

🏢 Company background

  • Founded by counterintelligence experts from the U.S. Intelligence Community.
  • Backed by 24+ AI-based patents, SOC 2 Type II, DoD Authority to Operate, and Certified B Corp status.
  • Has isolated production workflows across U.S. defense and global financial services since 2018.

#AIagents #governance #regulatedenterprises #AIsecurity #ReplicaCyber

Source: Replica Cyber Makes High-Risk AI Automation Safe for Financial Institutions
